top_signals.title: Dollar Logs Worst Week in Over Three Months Amid Fed Doubts
top_signals.summary: The dollar finished its worst week in over three months on concerns the Federal Reserve won’t move forcefully enough to contain inflation.

top_signals.title: Americans Are Richer Than Ever. Why Are They So Angry?
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Allison Schrager and David Gura join Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Schrager writes that "it is one of the great paradoxes of our time: Americans have never been richer — or more negative about the economy. More people are upper-middle class than ever, and even lower-income Americans are richer by almost every measure compared to previous generations. And yet more than three in five Americans say the economy is not working for them." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: New Zealand Housing Market Faces Biggest ‘Down Phase’ in Decades
top_signals.summary: New Zealand house prices fell to a three-year low in July, extending a slump that began in early 2022 and leaving the market in its weakest state in decades.

top_signals.title: New York imports more electricity from Canada after high-voltage transmission line opens
top_signals.summary: On July 3, 2026, the New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) imported 52 gigawatthours (GWh) of electricity from Canada, the most traded between the two areas since January 2025. Some of the imported electricity flowed along the new Champlain Hudson Power Express (CHPE) transmission line between Quebec, Canada, and New York City, which officially reached commercial operations in May after three years of construction.
